# verify_server

[← Command index](README.md)

Check that a server's hardening actually took effect.

## Synopsis

```
verify_server [options]
```

## Description

Runs a set of checks against a server entry from `[UserData.Servers]` in
`~/JoyBox.ini`, over the same SSH connection the bootstrap uses, or against this
machine when `--server` is omitted. Nothing has to be installed on the target.

Every check tests the effect rather than the configuration:

- Container port bindings: no container publishes on `0.0.0.0`, and `ss` shows no
  unexpected wildcard listeners.
- Firewall: ufw is active, not just installed.
- sshd: the effective config (`sshd -T`) has password authentication off and root
  login restricted.
- fail2ban: the `sshd` and `nginx-http-auth` jails are running.
- Docker daemon: `userns-remap` and `no-new-privileges` are configured, and
  userns-remap is active.
- Rate limiting and headers: nginx defines and uses a `limit_req` zone and has
  `server_tokens off`. With `--domain`, 40 requests are sent to it from the server
  and at least one must be refused.
- Unattended upgrades: the JoyBox config is present with automatic reboot enabled.

A check whose tool is not installed on the target is reported as skipped rather than
failed. The command exits with the number of failed checks, so it works as a gate.

## Options

### General

| Option | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| `-s, --server <server>` | Index of the `server_<n>_*` entry to check over SSH, e.g. `0`; this machine when omitted. |
| `-d, --domain <domain>` | Domain to send a burst of HTTPS requests to, to prove rate limiting refuses them; no burst when omitted. |

### Common options

| Option | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| `-v, --verbose` | Enable verbose mode. |
| `-p, --pretend_run` | Do a pretend run with no permanent changes. |
| `-x, --exit_on_failure` | Enable exit on failure mode. |
| `--no-preview` | Skip the preview confirmation prompt. |

## Examples

### Check server entry 0, including a rate-limit burst

```bash
verify_server --server 0 --domain joybox.test
```

### Check this machine

```bash
verify_server
```

### Check a server and fail a script if anything is wrong

```bash
verify_server -s 1 -d example.com || echo "hardening incomplete"
```

## Notes

- The sshd, firewall, fail2ban and nginx checks run their commands with sudo on the target.
- Without `--domain` the rate-limit burst is skipped; the domain is not read from `domain_name`.
- Each check is a function in `Shared/joybox/hardening.py` and can be run on its own from Python.
